families.label: Photo-scanned
families.source: Poly Haven (CC0), including OpenLegend’s simplified versions
families.note: Scanned real objects with physically based textures. Poly Haven is the endorsed starting point for natural objects and materials.

families.label: Stylized textured
families.source: Quaternius MegaKits (CC0), including the canopy trees
families.note: Painted-looking textures on softened, believable shapes. Mike liked these trees on October 31, 2026.

families.label: Fantasy Creatures
families.source: Fantasy Creatures by Daniel Gruginski (CC0), built by AI-written Blender scripts
families.note: Rigged animals with natural proportions and painted coats, each in its default coat. Found on November 3, 2026 as a free candidate for the direction’s animals.

families.label: WildMesh 3D
families.source: WildMesh 3D’s free animated animals on Sketchfab (CC BY 4.0)
families.note: Rigged wild animals with painted coats and no shine, as Sketchfab exports them, each standing in the first frame of its idle. Added on November 3, 2026 as a free candidate for the direction’s animals; their creator calls them older versions with known rigging problems.

families.label: Current game picks
families.source: Mixed community and generated sources curated by OpenLegend
families.note: Models the game uses now that do not belong to one of the other families.

families.label: Clean low-poly
families.note: Flat colours and simple geometric forms. Outside the current direction, which rejects a visibly low-poly look.

families.label: Classic low-poly
families.source: Quaternius classic packs and community models (CC0)
families.note: Faceted flat-shaded forms. Outside the current direction, which rejects a visibly low-poly look.

families.label: Chunky toy
families.note: Rounded toy-like forms on a shared gradient atlas. Mike rejected this style on October 16, 2026; shown only as a reference point.

families.label: Engine-drawn
families.note: Surfaces the renderer draws itself rather than loading a model.
